2609.19656.title: Self-Evolving Search Index
2609.19656.paper_summary: Information retrieval is increasingly important as LLM agents tackle complex tasks involving diverse information needs. Because retrieval relies on an index that represents each document through index keys, retrieval quality depends heavily on how effectively these keys expose the knowledge contained in each document. However, effective index representations vary across retrieval environments, making it difficult for any fixed optimization strategy to perform consistently. Yet evolving an index to its retrieval environment remains largely human-driven, requiring humans to diagnose retrieval failures, refine the optimization strategy, and reprocess the index accordingly. We propose SELF-INDEX, a framework that enables an index to self-evolve without human intervention. Its Optimizer autonomously diagnoses retrieval shortfalls, selectively revises the responsible index keys, and validates each revision before updating the index. Beyond reacting to observed retrieval demands, SELF-INDEX proactively explores additional demands through a Query Simulator, allowing the index to evolve beyond the queries already available for optimization. Across diverse corpora and retrievers, SELF-INDEX consistently improves retrieval performance while outperforming existing index optimization methods. We further show that these benefits extend to downstream applications, improving the effectiveness and efficiency of search agents and helping agent memory systems retrieve useful past interactions.
2609.19656.paper_summary_zh: 資訊檢索在大型語言模型（LLM）代理處理涉及多樣化信息需求的複雜任務時變得越來越重要。由於檢索依賴於通過索引鍵表示每個文檔的索引，因此檢索質量在很大程度上取決於這些鍵如何有效地揭示每個文檔中所包含的知識。然而，有效的索引表示在不同的檢索環境中有所不同，這使得任何固定的優化策略難以保持一致的表現。然而，將索引演變為其檢索環境仍然主要依賴人類驅動，這需要人類診斷檢索失敗、完善優化策略並相應地重新處理索引。我們提出了SELF-INDEX，一個使索引能夠在無需人類干預的情況下自我演變的框架。其優化器自主診斷檢索不足，選擇性地修訂負責的索引鍵，並在更新索引之前驗證每次修訂。在反應觀察到的檢索需求之外，SELF-INDEX通過查詢模擬器主動探索額外的需求，允許索引超越已可用於優化的查詢進行演變。在多樣的語料庫和檢索器中，SELF-INDEX始終提高檢索性能，同時超越現有的索引優化方法。我們進一步顯示，這些好處延伸到下游應用，提高了搜索代理的有效性和效率，並幫助代理記憶系統檢索有用的過去互動。
